1000.tip: Talk-only: Heena sends you to Sera; no hunting needed. Grab it while you pass through Mushroom Town.

1001.tip: Just carry Sera's mirror back to Heena.

1002.tip: Quick starter quest from Roger in Mushroom Town; do it while exploring.
1002.worthReason: SSEGold: do it while exploring; costs almost no time.

1003.tip: Talk-only: Nina sends you to Sen, then back to Nina.

1005.tip: Kill 3 Tutorial Jr. Sentinels and pick up 3 Jr. Sentinel Shellpieces at the East Entrance to Mushroom Town.

1006.tip: Snail Hunting Ground II covers this and Biggs's Blue Snail Shells at once. Must be turned in before Mai will give Mai's Training.

1007.tip: Talk-only delivery from Maria to Lucas; the reply pays a random Skullcap or Headband, a free starter hat.

1009.tip: Needs Sam's Suggestion done first. Kill 10 Blue Snails, 10 Shrooms and 5 Red Snails on one loop between Mushroom Town and Amherst.

1010.tip: One Orange Mushroom kill, found west of Amherst (Field West of Amherst / Dangerous Forest). Afterwards Mai points you to the Southperry boat.

1011.tip: Biggs is on the left side of Southperry. Farm the 10 Blue Snail Shells together with Sam's snails, and the single Orange Mushroom Cap in Dangerous Forest. Dagger reward is a coin flip: Fruit Knife or Razor.
1011.worthReason: SSEGold: do it; random weapon reward.

1012.tip: Rusty Screws and Old Wooden Boards come from breaking the wooden boxes around Amherst. The Green Relaxer chair is only obtainable here; if the boxes are camped, Mina in Lith Harbor sells a Sky-blue Wooden Chair for 1,000 mesos instead.
1012.worthReason: SSEGold: EXP and mesos; only source of The Green Relaxer (MeowDB).

1013.tip: Rain is on the left side of Amherst. Answer: Up arrow key. All 7 together pay 490 EXP and 10 Oranges.

1014.tip: Rain is on the left side of Amherst. Answer: Oh yes.

1015.tip: Rain is on the left side of Amherst. Answer: Equipment inventory.

1016.tip: Rain is on the left side of Amherst. Answer: Sleep.

1017.tip: Rain is on the left side of Amherst. Answer: Level 10.

1018.tip: Rain is on the left side of Amherst. Answer: 5 points.

1019.tip: Rain is on the left side of Amherst. Answer: Southperry. Rain then sends you to Southperry to sail.

10000.tip: Thicket Around the Beach I, right outside Lith Harbor, has both the Stumps and Slimes; turn in to Olaf in Lith Harbor.

10001.tip: Start at level 8, finish by returning to Phil (left side of Lith Harbor) once you hit 10. Job advancement can't be undone, so pick your class carefully.

10002.tip: Jane is on the left side of Lith Harbor (not Jane Doe in Kerning). Blue Mushroom Caps: Blue Mushroom Forest; Horny Mushroom Caps: Ant Tunnel III/IV. The weapon attack scroll is random from 14 types.
10002.worthReason: MeowDB recommends it; SSEGold: early weapon-scroll upgrade.

10003.tip: Needs Pure Water (shop, 1,120 mesos) plus Copper Drake/Wraith kills and Drake Skulls/Medicine With Weird Vibes; Wraiths are in the Kerning subway.
10003.worthReason: SSEGold calls the Jane the Alchemist chain one of the most valuable scroll quests.

10004.tip: Mushmom Spore comes from Someone Else's House (hidden map off Pig Park II). Drake's Blood has no confirmed source yet, so start looking early.

10005.tip: The Moon Rock is traded from Arwen in Ellinia (ingots plus 10,000 mesos). Dragon Skin and Sap of Ancient Tree sources were still unconfirmed in Classic. Reward is a random gloves scroll.

10006.tip: Enter the jump quest through the Mysterious Statue in Sleepywood. No Haste/movement skills, summoning bags or Teleport Rock inside. Level was raised from 45 to 65 before launch.

10007.tip: Re-enter via the statue for each stage and take from the matching flower pile; talk to John again after each turn-in. Pays class gloves.

10008.tip: Final run pays the Pink-Flowered Earrings (Lv 60, 5 slots, crit damage), the headline reward of the chain.
10008.worthReason: SSEGold: large EXP (77,700 over the chain).

10009.tip: Unlocks after Olaf's First Training; talk to Olaf again in Lith Harbor.

10010.tip: The Slime Bubble is a drop, so keep killing Slimes (Thicket Around the Beach I) until it appears.

10011.tip: Talk to Teo again; Pigs for the Pig's Head are on Thicket Around the Beach II. Pays a Sniper Potion and 10 Lemons.

10100.tip: Slime Bubbles (The Tree That Grew II) and Pig's Ribbons (L Forest I) are in different towns, so plan the route. Pays 20 Lemons, handy MP pots for mages.

10103.tip: Pays 20 Lemons (MP potions), which the Magician guide points out. Also a prerequisite for the Henesys citizenship story After the Festival Ends.

10104.tip: Pia is under the watchtower in Henesys Park. Green caps: West Rocky Mountain III; Blue caps: Blue Mushroom Forest. Pays a Hat Accuracy scroll.
10104.worthReason: SSEGold: do it if you're training on mushrooms anyway.

10105.tip: Just deliver the marble to Utah at Utah's Pig Farm (through The Forest East of Henesys). 30% chance of Pig Illustrated, otherwise 30 Cakes.

10106.tip: Long fetch chain across Henesys, Lith Harbor and Perion; big total payout (12,529 EXP, Brown Bamboo Hat).
10106.worthReason: SSEGold: large EXP for the chain.

10107.tip: Teo (Lith Harbor) will only swap Weird Medicine for a Sparkling Rock; Sophia at the Perion Department Store can make one.

10110.tip: Manji wants the Zombie Mushroom kills first, then the Charms of the Undead; Ant Tunnel III is the best map.

10111.tip: Leaf: Dark Stumps (West Domain of Perion). Octopus Leg: Damp Tree-Forest. Squishy Liquid's drop source wasn't confirmed.

10112.tip: Trade the rock to Teo, deliver to Maya. Completing this unlocks Maya's Collection quests.

10113.tip: Luke guards the Henesys Dungeon Entrance. Jr. Necki: Dangerous Croko I; Stirges: Transfer Area. Buy the Salad (220 mesos) and bring everything at once. Pays a random refined jewel.

10114.tip: Crafting-heavy: Black Feather from Arwen, Orihalcon Ingots (Smithing 5), Screws, Drake Skulls (Drake's Meal Table). Dragon Skin source unconfirmed. Pays Bronze Crusader Helm.

10115.tip: Requires Delivering the Weird Medicine. 20 each of Orange, Green, Blue and Horny Mushroom Caps.

10116.tip: Pig's Ribbon (L Forest I), Bubbling's Huge Bubble (Line 1), Fire Boar's Tooth (Burnt Land V), Tablecloth (Line 2).

10117.tip: Iron Hog (Pig Park II), Lupin (Monkey Swamp I), Cold Eye, Tortie (Hot Sand) drops; talk to Maya again after the first set.

10118.tip: Stone Golem Rubble (Golem's Temple III), Dark Stone Golem Rubble (Sleepy Dungeon V) and a Diamond (Arcforge 6 from Diamond Ore). Pays the Green Napoleon cape.

10119.tip: Silver Ingots via Smithing 4, Screws via crafting; Dragon Skin source still unconfirmed.

10121.tip: Rina wants Medicine With Weird Vibes (Wraiths, Line 2 <Area 3>), an Ancient Scroll (rare) and a Black Crystal.

10124.tip: Requires The Stump Horror Story and The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies. Carry Ayan's Toy Sword from Bruce (Henesys) to Ayan (Perion).

10125.tip: Take Ayan's letter back to Bruce. Prerequisite for Taking Out the Alligators and for the Henesys citizenship story Bruce's Dilemma.

10126.tip: Starts with Pia in Henesys Park; then ask Jay and Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys.

10128.tip: Wing the Fairy (Ellinia) wants 20 each of Snail, Blue Snail and Red Snail Shells; Red ones from The Field West of Amherst on Victoria.

10129.tip: Mano roams Thicket Around the Beach near Lith Harbor and spawns only about once an hour, so time your visit.

10130.tip: Final hand-in to Pia pays nothing, and using the shell just turns you into a snail.
10130.worthReason: henesys.gg: the last step gives no reward.

10200.tip: Arwen is far left in Ellinia; the Glass Shoe drops from Fire Boars (Burnt Land III/V). 50% chance of Piece of Ice, which Manji's Gladius chain needs.
10200.conflict: henesys.gg says this quest is repeatable with no timer; the app's data marks it non-repeatable.

10201.tip: Requires Returned Secret Book. Zombie Lupins drop the dolls; Monkey Swamp III is the densest map. The five stages need 570 dolls in all.
10201.chain: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll

10204.tip: Pays an Intermediate Gloves ATT or M.ATT scroll (50/50).
10204.chain: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll

10205.tip: Final stage pays a class hat.
10205.chain: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll

10208.tip: Drake Skulls drop from Drakes at Drake's Meal Table (Sleepywood), not from Copper Drakes.
10208.chain: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House

10209.tip: Cold Eyes: The Tunnel That Lost Light I. Craft the Diamond at Arcforge 6. Chain pays a random Shoes Speed scroll.
10209.chain: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House

10213.tip: Lyn is in a hidden room above the Magic Library (exit via its top-left portal). Torn Ledger Pages come from Fairies in Tree Dungeon VI/VII or Someone Else's House, only 2 per map with slow respawn; Fairies have very high M.DEF, so mages should bring a weapon user.
10213.worthReason: MeowDB: free Lv 28 earrings with 5 slots; SSEGold: large EXP (24,540 total).

10214.tip: Stan hands you the ledger; Manji in Perion needs to be spoken to twice.

10215.tip: Nothing to collect; just travel to Chrishrama in Sleepywood.

10216.tip: Chrishrama is just left of the Sleepywood Hotel door; talk to him again for the Bound Ledger and take it to the Receptionist inside. Pays 10 Mana Elixirs.

10217.tip: Dark Lord's hideout door is right of the Kerning Pharmacy; Alex is on the rooftop straight above the Pharmacy door.

10218.tip: Grendel hands you the Amended Ledger; return to Lyn through the Magic Library's top-left portal. Pays Faded Maple Leaf Earrings and 2 fame.

10300.tip: Alex is on the Kerning City rooftop, right side. 15 Green (West Rocky Mountain III) + 15 Blue Mushroom Caps (Blue Mushroom Forest).
10300.worthReason: Recommended by MeowDB's beginner guide (3,159 EXP + mesos for the chain).

10301.tip: Chief Stan won't discuss Alex until you hand over the caps.

10302.tip: Bring the watch back to Alex; choose Weighted Earrings or Yellow Square (Weighted Earrings are needed later in the fossil chain).

10303.tip: Nella (middle of Kerning City) charges 1,000 mesos before handing out jobs. Orange Mushroom Caps + Pig's Ribbons (Ribbon Pigs, L Forest I).
10303.worthReason: MeowDB's beginner guide lists the Nella chain as a recommended Lv 10+ quest (Work Gloves).

10304.tip: Dark Stumps for Leaves, best at West Domain of Perion.

10305.tip: Octopus Legs from Octopuses (Damp Tree-Forest) plus 1 Pure Water bought for 1,120 mesos.

10306.tip: Jr. Necki and Horny Mushrooms both in Swamp of Despair II; pays 30 White Potions.
10306.chain: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Other Request

10307.tip: Leather from Pigs (Thicket Around the Beach II). henesys.gg had no Stiff Feather source, but MeowDB lists Pigs, Ribbon Pigs, Stirges and Wild Boars as droppers.
10307.chain: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Other Request

10308.tip: Evil Eye Tails from Cave of Evil Eye II/III near Sleepywood; pays class boots.
10308.chain: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Other Request

10309.tip: Jane Doe is at Niora Hospital (right side of Kerning). Stirges for Broken Mirror Glass are in the subway Transfer Area.

10310.tip: Zombie Mushrooms in Ant Tunnel II/III for Charms of the Undead. Pays the Old Raggedy Cape (Lv 25, +1 accuracy) usable by any class.
10310.worthReason: Recommended in MeowDB's Warrior, Thief and beginner guides for the cape.

10311.tip: This is the Kerning City Party Quest: party of 4, all Lv 21+, leader talks to Lakelis. Kill King Slime at the end. Earring scroll reward is random.
10311.worthReason: SSEGold: random earring scroll is a gear upgrade.

10312.tip: Enter through The Ticket Gate with a ticket (one per floor). 99-minute timer; no movement skills, summoning bags, Mystic Door or Teleport Rock. The item only exists while the quest is active.
10312.worthReason: MeowDB beginner guide recommends it (20,160 EXP + 12,222 mesos for the chain); SSEGold: do.

10313.tip: Return to Shumi between floors; this one pays 30 Blue Potions.

10315.tip: Icarus is on top of a building in Kerning City; answer his questions.

10316.tip: Tree Branches come from Stumps (The Tree That Grew II). The Squishy Liquid drop source wasn't confirmed on henesys.gg.

10317.tip: Stirge Wings from the Transfer Area; Processed Wood is crafted from 10 Tree Branches + 100 mesos; Stiff Feathers drop from Pigs, Ribbon Pigs, Stirges and Wild Boars (per MeowDB).

10318.tip: Tablecloths from Jr. Wraiths on Line 2 <Area 1>. henesys.gg had no source for Alligator Skin Pouch.

10319.tip: Needs Icarus's Dream done and Lv 46; Wing the Fairy is on the right side of Ellinia.
10319.worthReason: SSEGold lists Icarus and the Flying Medicine as a do.

10320.tip: Medicine With Weird Vibes from Wraiths, best at Line 2 <Area 3>. Witchgrass Leaf source wasn't listed.

10321.tip: Talk to Wing twice, then bring the medicine to Icarus for a random Green/Yellow/Blue cape.

10400.tip: Stumps (Tree Branch) and Dark Stumps (Leaf) both spawn on The Field South of Ellinia and The Tree That Grew II. Shield is random: Wooden Buckler 90%, Steel Shield 10%.
10400.worthReason: Recommended in MeowDB's Warrior guide for the shield.

10401.tip: Needs Fixing Blackbull's House done. 100 Stone Golem Rubble (Golem's Temple III), crafted Screws and Processed Wood, and the Deed from Curse Eyes in Deep Forest I/II. Pick a Greater attack scroll for your class.
10401.worthReason: SSEGold: do it for gearing (Greater attack scroll).

10402.tip: Carry the sword from Manji (left side of Perion) to Chrishrama in Sleepywood.

10403.tip: Prepare early: Star Rock (Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine or Arwen), Piece of Ice (50% from Arwen and the Glass Shoe), Ancient Scroll and Flaming Feather (drops unconfirmed in Classic).

10404.tip: Back to Manji; choose Hero's Gladius or Skull Earrings.

10405.tip: Winston is on East Rocky Mountain II. Green Mushrooms: West Rocky Mountain III; Axe Stumps also spawn on East Rocky Mountain II/III. Plant/Animal Fossil drop sources weren't listed.

10406.tip: Talk to Winston a second time for the Fossil Box and letter, then take both to Betty on the left side of Ellinia.

10407.tip: Betty wants 8 Plant Samples; their source wasn't confirmed in the game files.

10408.tip: Fetch the Stuffed Drake Skull from Anne on The Hill East of Henesys.

10410.tip: Winston also wants Leaves, Firewood, a rare Stump's Teardrop (Dark Axe Stump, East Rocky Mountain V) and Weighted Earrings (Serabi, Ellinia, 9,000 mesos). Tip: Alex the Runaway Kid offers Weighted Earrings as a reward choice. Pays Leaf Earrings.
10410.worthReason: SSEGold lists Dr. Betty's Research on Plants as a do.

10411.tip: Ayan won't leave Perion, so turn in there. Stumps are right outside Perion (West Street Corner, West Rocky Mountain I). Pays 2 Return Scrolls to Perion. Needed for I Need to Find My Daughter.

10412.tip: Needs I Need to Find My Daughter done. Jr. Necki: Dangerous Croko I; Ligators: Swamp of Despair I. Pick a Greater attack scroll for your class.

10413.tip: 120 Crocos and 50 Croco Skins; Dangerous Croko II is best. Pays an Intermediate cape stat scroll of your choice.

10414.tip: Long talk relay: Winston -> Blackbull -> Ayan -> Manji -> Dances with Balrog -> Betty (Ellinia) -> Winston.

10420.tip: 100 Very Dry Branches from stumps around Perion is the slow part; collect them while you train nearby.

10421.tip: Stumpy (Lv 35) appears on Parched Land in Perion about once an hour, one at a time. Reward is a Gloves Crit. Rate Scroll: Chaos.

10500.tip: Mr. Wetbottom is in the VIP Sauna in Sleepywood; look for it under the Available tab as Mr. Wetbottom's Secret Book. Ronnie hangs out in The Tree Tunnel At the Forest Up North, near Ellinia.
10500.worthReason: MeowDB class guides point to it for the Sauna Robe; SSEGold: large EXP (49,140 total).

10501.tip: Lupins for bananas live in the Ellinia monkey forests or Monkey Swamp I near Kerning; they are Lv 37, above the quest level.

10503.tip: Rina is on the left side of Henesys. Curse Eye Tails: Sleepy Dungeon V; Pig's Heads: Thicket Around the Beach II.

10506.tip: Rowen (right side of Ellinia) wants a Diamond, which you can craft at Arcforge Lv 6 from one Diamond Ore.

10508.tip: Pays the Sauna Robe: Blue for male, Red for female characters (+1 all stats, 10 slots). Also unlocks the Cursed Doll and Ronnie house chains.

10509.tip: Sabitrama stands in front of the Sleepywood Hotel; the jump quest entrance is via Shane in Ellinia, who charges a fee until you finish this quest. Movement skills are blocked except on Step 3.

10510.tip: Pays a Star Rock, which Manji's Gladius chain needs; Arwen in Ellinia can also trade you one.

10617.tip: Nyroth's failed Arcforge gives you the Scorched Arcon Scroll; deliver it to Jaime in Decayed Tunnel III. Pays a Cape Accuracy scroll. Forgotten Hollow is closed until the November 18 update.

10618.tip: 50 Echopuses: Perilous Descent I and II have 11 each, so use both maps. Item rewards are just fruit. Forgotten Hollow is closed until the November 18 update.

10619.tip: Daniel is at the Precipice of Darkness, where the Duskmanders spawn; Duskmanders resist poison. Richest quest in the area (Greater Bottomwear HP scroll, 15 Elixirs). Forgotten Hollow is closed until the November 18 update.
10619.worthReason: MeowDB: highest-value quest in the Forgotten Hollow chain.

10620.tip: Ends with a trip back to Grendel in Ellinia; plan your return. Forgotten Hollow is closed until the November 18 update.
10620.worthReason: MeowDB: one of the two highest-value Forgotten Hollow quests.

10700.tip: Riel is in the middle of Florina Beach. Over the 4 stages you need 65 Coconuts, 55 Lupin's Bananas, 100 Lorang Claws and 70 Clang Claws, so bank extras.

10702.tip: Heaviest stage; Clangs (Lv 49) are well above the quest level.

20000.tip: Start with Dances with Balrog (Warriors' Sanctuary, Perion) at Lv 30. Spend all 1st-job SP first: 2nd-job SP can't go into 1st-job skills.
20000.worthReason: SSEGold: do immediately; it's your 2nd job advancement.

20001.tip: Take the letter to the Warrior Job Instructor at West Rocky Mountain IV (right side).

20002.tip: The instructor warps you into the hidden Warrior's Rocky Mountain; hunt there until you have 30 Dark Marbles, then return to him.

20003.tip: Bring The Proof of a Hero back to your job NPC and pick Fighter, Page or Spearman.

20100.tip: Start with Grendel the Really Old (Magic Library, Ellinia) at Lv 30. Spend all 1st-job SP first: 2nd-job SP can't go into 1st-job skills.
20100.worthReason: SSEGold: do immediately; it's your 2nd job advancement.

20101.tip: Take the letter to the Magician Job Instructor at The Forest North of Ellinia.

20102.tip: The instructor warps you into the hidden Magician's Tree Dungeon; hunt there until you have 30 Dark Marbles, then return to him.

20103.tip: Bring The Proof of a Hero back to your job NPC and pick F/P Wizard, I/L Wizard or Cleric.

20200.tip: Start with Athena Pierce (Henesys) at Lv 30. Spend all 1st-job SP first: 2nd-job SP can't go into 1st-job skills.
20200.worthReason: SSEGold: do immediately; it's your 2nd job advancement.

20201.tip: Take the letter to the Bowman Job Instructor at The Road to the Dungeon (right side).

20202.tip: The instructor warps you into the hidden Ant Tunnel For Bowman; hunt there until you have 30 Dark Marbles, then return to him.

20203.tip: Bring The Proof of a Hero back to your job NPC and pick Hunter or Crossbowman.

20300.tip: Start with Dark Lord (Thieves' Hideout, Kerning City) at Lv 30. Spend all 1st-job SP first: 2nd-job SP can't go into 1st-job skills.
20300.worthReason: SSEGold: do immediately; it's your 2nd job advancement.

20301.tip: Take the letter to the Thief Job Instructor at Construction Site North of Kerning City (right side).

20302.tip: The instructor warps you into the hidden Thief's Construction Site; hunt there until you have 30 Dark Marbles, then return to him.

20303.tip: Bring The Proof of a Hero back to your job NPC and pick Assassin or Bandit.

80000.tip: Revives a pet that turned into a doll. Pass Trainer Bartos's test on Pet-Walking Road (Henesys) for the Water of Life and Life Scroll, then return to Mar in Marr's Forest near Ellinia.

80017.tip: Vicious is in Henesys Market. Woodcrafting makes arrows with no crafting fee (1 Processed Wood + 1 Stiff Feather = 500 arrows at skill 1), very handy for Bowmen.
80017.worthReason: MeowDB Bowman guide: cheap arrow supply.

80026.tip: Pure delivery chain: Lewis (Free Market Entrance, reachable from Henesys or Perion) -> Chief Stan -> back to Lewis.

80028.tip: Second letter goes to Dances with Balrog in Perion; bring his reply back to Lewis.

500000.tip: Closed-test event: finishing it in a test earned a Classic Beginnings Label Ring and Chat Ring, delivered to the mailbox at launch.

500001.tip: Closed-test event: if you finished it in a test, check your mailbox for the reward rings.

500010.tip: 100 Halloween Candies from Lv 10+ monsters to Malady, then her hidden mission, for the Pumpkin Basket. Can be farmed during the same sessions as The Journey Begins (overlap not confirmed by Nexon).

506000.tip: Citizenship sign-up for Henesys with Arthur at Henesys Town Hall from Lv 12. Citizenship is account-wide and switching towns later costs 100,000 mesos, so choose once.
506000.worthReason: MeowDB: probably worth it for regular players (shop/storage discounts, VIP dailies).

506001.tip: The Community Board posts one resident per day; First Greeting is once per resident, Asking After repeats. Rina pays Oranges, then Lemons on repeats.

506015.tip: VIP daily: about 17x the EXP of a normal resident greeting (5,850 vs 334). Only appears once your town grade is high enough.
506015.worthReason: MeowDB names VIP dailies a main reason citizenship is worth it; maplestory-classic.com lists the First Greetings among the best-paying early quests.
506015.conflict: MeowDB: VIP dailies unlock at grade 5 (Town Resident) and Lv 32; maplestory-classic.com lists them as level 12 quests (the app's data also says L12).

506016.tip: Repeatable VIP daily (4,095 EXP vs 233 for a normal resident). Only appears once your town grade is high enough.
506016.worthReason: MeowDB names VIP dailies a main reason citizenship is worth it; maplestory-classic.com lists the First Greetings among the best-paying early quests.
506016.conflict: MeowDB: VIP dailies unlock at grade 5 (Town Resident) and Lv 32; maplestory-classic.com lists them as level 12 quests (the app's data also says L12).

506017.tip: VIP daily: about 17x the EXP of a normal resident greeting (5,850 vs 334). Only appears once your town grade is high enough.
506017.worthReason: MeowDB names VIP dailies a main reason citizenship is worth it; maplestory-classic.com lists the First Greetings among the best-paying early quests.
506017.conflict: MeowDB: VIP dailies unlock at grade 5 (Town Resident) and Lv 32; maplestory-classic.com lists them as level 12 quests (the app's data also says L12).

506018.tip: Repeatable VIP daily (4,095 EXP vs 233 for a normal resident). Only appears once your town grade is high enough.
506018.worthReason: MeowDB names VIP dailies a main reason citizenship is worth it; maplestory-classic.com lists the First Greetings among the best-paying early quests.
506018.conflict: MeowDB: VIP dailies unlock at grade 5 (Town Resident) and Lv 32; maplestory-classic.com lists them as level 12 quests (the app's data also says L12).

506019.tip: Weekly board task: hand in 30 Blue Snail Shell. The items are the only cost; pays contribution plus 20 Blue Potions. Weekly reset reportedly Monday 00:00 UTC (unconfirmed).

general.text: Talk to every NPC on Maple Island: most hand out a small quest. Turn everything in before boarding Shanks's boat in Southperry, because the trip to Victoria Island is one-way. The Green Relaxer chair from Pio cannot be obtained anywhere else.

henesys.gg's optimizer suggests accepting every quest in a round before hunting: Snail Hunting Ground II covers Sam's and Biggs's snails together, and the talk-only quests (Sera, Sen, Lucas, Rain) can be chained while walking through.

Job instructors: Dances with Balrog (Perion), Grendel the Really Old (Ellinia Magic Library), Athena Pierce (Henesys), Dark Lord (Kerning City, Thieves' Hideout). Use taxis while still a Beginner, since they are 90% off.

MeowDB's class guides and henesys.gg say Classic World removed the stat requirements for 1st job (all at Lv 10). maplestory-classic.com's first-week guide still lists stat gates (e.g. Warrior STR 35, Magician INT 20 at Lv 8, Bowman/Thief DEX 25). Shown as a conflict, not resolved.

At Lv 30 your 1st-job NPC sends you to a Job Instructor, who warps you into a hidden test map to collect 30 Dark Marbles; trade them for The Proof of a Hero and return. Finish your 1st-job SP plan first: 2nd-job SP can't be spent on 1st-job skills. Test maps give about 1.7x normal EXP but you only pass through them.

MeowDB's beginner guide singles out: Nella's citizen requests (Lv 10, 1,000-meso fee), Alex the Runaway Kid (18), Jane and the Mushroom (20), Mystery of Niora Hospital (23, Old Raggedy Cape), What Shumi Lost (35). Don't sell quest items; check the Safe to Sell list first.

maplestory-classic.com ranks the VIP First Greetings, the Lv 27 citizenship quests (Chief Stan's Hammer, Nella's Old Memory), the Caretaker's Ledger chain (Lv 28), Arwen and the Glass Shoe (29) and Maya's Collections (30) as the best one-time payouts up to Lv 30. Quest mesos are one-time, so don't budget potions around them.

Unlocks at Lv 12 with Arthur (Henesys Town Hall) or Roxy (Kerning Civic Center). Account-wide; switching towns costs 100,000 mesos. Contribution comes from daily greetings (one resident posted per day; First Greeting once, Asking After repeats), weekly donations (30 of one ETC item, plus 20 Blue Potions), home quests and five 10-quest story arcs per town (Lv 17-57). Ten grades give 5-25% shop and 5-50% storage discounts and unlock shop items. Promote yourself at your town NPC; excess contribution may be lost (unconfirmed).

MeowDB: probably yes if you play regularly, use buff potions/return scrolls/pet food, or want VIP dailies; less useful for casual players since grade 10 needs steady daily and weekly work. Story-arc quests also pay scrolls (earring, overall, gloves crit) and the grade-10 earrings.

MeowDB's Warrior guide suggests Henesys (Arthur); its Magician guide recommends Kerning City for the INT overall scroll in Ben's shop at Distinguished Citizen. Pick early because switching costs 100,000 mesos.
MeowDB says VIP dailies (Chief Stan, Athena Pierce, Chun Ji, Dark Lord) unlock at grade 5 and Lv 32; maplestory-classic.com lists them at Lv 12. The app's data says L12.

The game data shows all donations at L12, but MeowDB lists level gates by item (e.g. Blue Mushroom Cap/Firewood 17, Horny Mushroom Cap 22, Evil Eye Tail 27, Ligator Skin 32, Lorang Claw/Lupin's Banana 37, Cold Eye Tail 42, Tortie Shell 47, Drake Skull/Medicine With Weird Vibes 52). EXP rises with the gate, from 334 to 14,200.
Available from Lv 21 in a party of four (Proof of Companionship with Lakelis). King Slime drops Squishy Shoes; MeowDB's Magician guide suggests Magic Guard 1 at Lv 21 for the King Slime fight.

Shumi's subway (Lv 35, ticket per floor, 99-minute timer), Sabitrama's Forest of Patience (Lv 25/50, enter via Shane in Ellinia), John's Deep Forest of Patience (Lv 65, enter via the Mysterious Statue in Sleepywood). All block movement skills and Teleport Rock.

New Lv 39-60 area; closed at launch and opening with the November 18, 2026 update. The chain starts with Grendel in Ellinia at Lv 39; entrance is The Tree Tunnel At the Forest Up North. Return Scrolls to Forgotten Hollow cost 800 mesos from Luma. Quest targets are spread out, so combine them with your hunting route.

Some later quests need rewards from earlier ones: Manji's Gladius needs a Star Rock (Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine, or Arwen) and a Piece of Ice (Arwen and the Glass Shoe); the fossil chain needs Weighted Earrings (offered by Alex the Runaway Kid). Diamonds for several quests can be crafted at Arcforge Lv 6.

As of launch week henesys.gg had no confirmed Classic World drop source for several quest items: Dragon Skin, Squishy Liquid, Drake's Blood, Sap of Ancient Tree, Ancient Scroll, Witchgrass Leaf, Alligator Skin Pouch, Fairy's Tentacle, Plant Samples. Expect extra searching for quests that need them.

Several reward picks are random rather than chosen (Jane and the Mushroom's weapon scroll, Proof of Companionship's earring scroll, Biggs's dagger, Blackbull's shield), so don't plan around a specific result.
